notes.title: Nomad Monthly Mailbag + More Platforms
notes.notes:
Howdy Fighting Fantasy fans!

It's been a long while since we last talked to you all via Steam, but we've got some things to talk about!

[b]The Nomad Games Monthly Mailbag[/b]

Since August, we've been opening up our inbox to questions from our community! So far we've had a ton of questions about game development, how we work and all of the different games we've made. You can check out the first Nomad Monthly Mailbag over on our [url=https://nomadgames.co.uk/blog/august-2021-mailbag]website[/url].

We haven't had a ton of [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] related questions yet, so I want to reach out to our fans here and see if you had anything you wanted to ask us! You can ask us about developing our own Fighting Fantasy games, what we'd like to do in the future or what our favourite books are!

If you do have a question, all you need to do is send over your questions to questions@nomadgames.co.uk and we'll answer each and every question we get! Questions!

[b]Fighting Fantasy Legends comes to Switch[/b]

In other news, we're bringing more [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] goodness to more platforms! We're super proud of the work we've done on both [i]Fighting Fantasy Legends[/i] and [i]Deathtrap Dungeon Trilogy[/i], and we can't wait for more players to experience these classic books.

We'll be launching it on Nintendo Switch today (September 23rd), and we're hoping that a whole new wave of adventurers see how much there is to love about [i]Fighting Fantasy.[/i]

notes.title: Fighting Fantasy Legends Stream, Thu, 5pm (UK)
notes.notes:
Hey all,

So, we'll be streaming Fighting Fantasy Legends which you'll be able to find over on our [url=https://go.twitch.tv/nomad_games]Twitch channel[/url] or over on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMnMgatmwZMVR5rpZEQleyw]YouTube channel[/url]. 

We're taking a welcome break from our regular broadcast of Talisman to have a love stroll through the plains of Alansia. Buying some bread, finding some garlic, killing some Hags - you know how it is. We'll also take input from the audience so if you've got any desires to help or hinder our journey feel free to join in!

We aim to be live at 5pm UK (6pm CET, 12pm EST, 9am PST), weather depending. If you've any Fighting Fantasy Legends related questions, want to know the latest FFL news or if you wanna try and get something for free, we'll see you then.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29088907/669e435bc8e0f2121c356b0685ed5f88a8f6b692.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fighting Fantasy Legends reshuffles the gamebooks
notes.notes: Three of Steve Jackson and Ian Livingstone’s Fighting Fantasy gamebooks collide and smoosh together with a card game in Fighting Fantasy Legends [official site], released today. If you’re old enough that you already know Warlock of Firetop Mountain, City of Thieves, and Citadel of Chaos back-to-front and smashed through Firetop’s video game adaptation by Tin Man Games, hey, here’s some of your childhood reworked in another way. Made by Talisman converters Nomad Games, Fighting Fantasy Legends is a roguelikelikey take on the books with a deck of cards throwing up surprises. Look: (more…)

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Fighting Fantasy Legends, 10% off!
notes.notes:
Fighting Fantasy Legends is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

Create your own adventures in a dangerous land of monsters, treasures and traps. From renowned authors Steve Jackson and Ian Livingstone (co-founders of Games Workshop) and Nomad Games, Fighting Fantasy Legends is a role-playing card game set in the world of Fighting Fantasy.
